title: Zen Browser profiles
whyItMatters: Zen keeps its browser profiles, history, cookies, saved logins and workspaces here. A profile on this computer shows the browser was used and how many separate identities were kept.
source: Zen Browser release notes: Linux configuration under ~/.config/zen since 1.18.6b - https://zen-browser.app/release-notes
notes: Each profile is a subfolder with prefs.js, history, cookies, logins and Zen workspace state. Older tarball installs may still use ~/.zen; Flatpak uses ~/.var/app/app.zen_browser.zen. Profile names are random per install.

cleanup.exportFirst: In Zen, export bookmarks to an HTML file and save any passwords you need from the browser's password settings.
cleanup.signOut: Sign out of Mozilla Sync in Zen settings, or disconnect this profile from the account, so the account no longer trusts this browser.
steps: Uninstall Zen from your software manager, or from Flatpak if you installed it that way.
Delete the Zen folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes every Zen profile on this computer: history, bookmarks, cookies, saved logins and workspaces.
